_comment: Phase-2 source B: FULL non-path_only atlas over the intended MVP assembly family. d=base_species_count in {2,3}; mu=max complex support/order is 5, so homomeric/mixed complexes such as AAAAA, AAAAB, AABBB, and BBBBC are in scope. sqlite_persist_mode=full persists network_entries/behavior_slices/regime/transition/family/path records; compute_volume=true adds volume/robustness evidence. change_expansion.max_active_dims=1 keeps slices single-axis (one swept qK total) so the v0 phenotyper can sweep them. ATLAS_SQLITE_PATH env overrides sqlite_path at run time.
